name: Cone of Boiling Acid
body:
School evocation [acid, fire]; Level magus 6, shaman 7, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch 7

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.

This spell functions as cone of boiling acid except the cone is larger and the maximum damage is increased to 15d6.
